sources.quote:
## May 2025

### Cached prompt is now available

You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts. For
more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI’s own release notes place cached prompts in May 2025, before models.dev first recorded this model price on June 10; this supports that the June 17 addition is not evidence of a newly introduced caching feature.

notes: The models.dev commit describes a schema cleanup (renaming cache fields and removing zero-valued fields), not a provider pricing announcement; xAI’s release notes say cached prompts were available in May 2025. I classify this as models_dev_fix, but the available provider source does not state Grok 3 Mini’s official token rates during the earlier period, so those values and an effective date are left unknown.
